decision: Retain adaptive small-response sending; reject immutable response snapshots and the blocking-read runtime hint.

scoring.final_comparison: arithmetic mean of fresh trial geomeans, each using its three original round medians

method.network: One runsc-netstack sandbox, loopback, network=none; Go core and sealed client share the sandbox quota.
method.layout_limit: The final aggregate 4-CPU/1280-MiB rig approximates the production pod sum. It does not enforce the separate entry 2-CPU/1-GiB and env 2-CPU/256-MiB member limits.
method.trial: Fresh container, sealed conformance, original fixtures, five warmups, exactly three timed rounds. One core and one client per trial.
method.order: Base then candidate on odd pairs; candidate then base on even pairs. No concurrent benchmark, profiler, strace or compilation on the rig.
method.cpu: Forge process /proc/PID/stat utime+stime at round boundaries, all process threads, 100 Hz (10 ms quantization).
method.interval: 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples of whole fresh-trial pairs, seed 20261118; 95% percentiles. Pair and block sensitivity checks preserve the batch and AB/BA grouping.
method.launcher: Native counts include a whole-tree trace: Go PID 16194 listened directly on the registered port, Node supervisor PID 16163 had no workload TCP exchanges. Go exec preceded the first timed round by 2.2593 s. The rig launches the core directly; launcher startup is outside the graded benchmark.
